title: Remove the ai-output sample dump
findings_note: ai-output/chatgpt-output.md (1,167 lines of generated sample code and docs that mention an MIT licence, in an MPL-2.0 repo)
boundary: **Not in this slice:** editing `specs-and-reqs.md` or any other document.

sections.heading: Why
sections.body: The directory holds a generated example project unrelated to the current code. It mentions an MIT licence in an MPL-2.0 repository, nothing builds or references it, and F-Droid and Play reviewers would have to ask what it is. The owner decided to delete it.

sections.heading: Implement
sections.body:
1. Check for references: `rg -n "ai-output|chatgpt-output" --glob '!ai-output/**' --glob '!.slicer/**'`. If anything refers to it, remove or fix that reference.
2. `git rm -r ai-output`.
3. Keep `specs-and-reqs.md`.

sections.heading: Check
sections.body:
- The `rg` command above returns nothing.
- `./gradlew assembleDebug` still passes.
